Visit Þingvellir National Park, Geysir, and Gullfoss, and enjoy a small local Icelandic touch included along the way. Golden Circle Day Tour with Local Surprise (English Guide) Explore Iceland’s iconic Golden Circle, featuring Þingvellir National Park, the Geysir geothermal area, the majestic Gullfoss waterfall, and the colorful Kerið volcanic crater. This full-day tour normally runs from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM and is available daily for all travelers. On selected dates, additional departures are scheduled specifically for cruise ship passengers. These cruise-focused tours are timed to match individual ship schedules and are clearly labeled with the cruise ship name. Cruise passengers are kindly asked to select the departure that corresponds to their ship and port date to ensure appropriate pickup and return timing. On some of these selected cruise dates, German-guided departures are also available. Please select the German option during booking if preferred. Experience the warmth of local culture through engaging storytelling and authentic moments that enrich the journey. The itinerary is thoughtfully paced to allow ample time at each stop, combining Iceland’s most famous natural landmarks with a relaxed and memorable travel experience. Highlights Visit Þingvellir National Park, a UNESCO World Heritage Site Discover the geothermal activity at the Geysir area Witness the raw power of Gullfoss waterfall Explore Kerið volcanic crater with its striking colors and crater lake Daily regular departures operate from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, unless a different time is shown on your voucher. Additional cruise-specific departures available on selected dates, aligned with ship schedules What's included? The bus may arrive anytime within the 30-minute pickup window starting from the tour departure time shown on your voucher. • Cruise ship passengers : On cruise days, we operate dedicated departures aligned with ship schedules. Please follow the pickup and meeting time shown for the specific date you select during booking, as it may differ from the standard departure time and is tailored to cruise port hours.
